description: This file contains functions and types for importing and exporting configuration settings, including file handling, validation, and UI interactions within a VSCode extension context.

methods.name: importSettingsFromPath
methods.description: Imports configuration settings from a specified file path, validating and merging data, updating proxies, and handling errors.

methods.name: importSettings
methods.description: Opens a file dialog for the user to select a JSON settings file and imports the configuration.

methods.name: importSettingsFromFile
methods.description: Imports configuration settings directly from a given file URI.

methods.name: exportSettings
methods.description: Exports current configuration settings to a user-specified JSON file.

methods.name: importSettingsWithFeedback
methods.description: Performs import with UI feedback, validating file access, updating provider state, and showing success or error messages.
